title: Invoice Automation System
shortDescription: An AI workflow that reads invoices, extracts the data, and organizes it automatically.
problem: An accounting team spent hours every week opening invoices, reading them, and retyping the data into their accounting system — a slow process that was prone to errors and scaled poorly as the business grew.
solution: Floza built an AI workflow that reads incoming invoices, extracts the key fields, and writes structured data straight into the accounting system. The team only reviews the exceptions the system flags.
workflow: Data validated and written to the accounting system
results: Hours of manual data entry removed every week
Invoices processed in minutes instead of days

title: AI Lead Qualification CRM
shortDescription: A system that talks to prospects, qualifies them, and organizes every lead in a CRM.
problem: A service business received dozens of inquiries a day but had no system for sorting them. Good leads went cold while the team chased inquiries that were never going to convert.
solution: Floza created a qualification workflow that talks to prospects, asks the right questions, scores every lead, and organizes them in a simple CRM with clear follow-up priorities.
workflow: Inquiry arrives from the website or chat
CRM entry created with next steps
results: Every lead captured and organized automatically
Sales team focuses on the hottest leads first

title: Business Reporting Dashboard
shortDescription: A custom dashboard that centralizes business data and reporting in one place.
problem: Financial data lived in spreadsheets and separate tools, so getting a clear picture of the business meant hours of manual consolidation at the end of every month.
solution: Floza built a custom dashboard that pulls the business's data into one place, with clean reporting views the whole team can read at a glance.

title: Accounting Firm Website
shortDescription: A modern business website that turns visitors into booked consultations.
problem: An accounting firm's outdated website didn't explain their services clearly and wasn't driving inquiries, so most new clients came from word of mouth.
solution: Floza designed and built a modern business website that explains their services, builds trust with clear content, and guides visitors toward booking a consultation.
results: Easy to update without technical help

title: AI Customer Support Agent
shortDescription: An AI assistant that answers common questions instantly and escalates complex cases.
problem: A growing online business was answering the same customer questions repeatedly, leaving the team little time for complex or high-value requests.
solution: Floza built an AI support assistant trained on the business's information that answers common questions instantly, collects important details, and escalates complex cases to the team.
results: Support team freed for complex cases
